examples.english: He has a lead of five seconds in the race.
examples.persian: او پنج ثانیه در مسابقه جلو است.

miniContext: Lead (n) is the position ahead of others in a race, competition or contest.

examples.english: I'm writing the first draft of a letter.
examples.persian: دارم اولین پیش‌نویس یک نامه را می‌نویسم.

miniContext: Draft means to write the first version of sth such as a letter, speech or book.

examples.english: They are using sea transport for our luggage.
examples.persian: برای چمدان‌های ما از حمل‌ونقل دریایی استفاده می‌کنند.

miniContext: Transport means to take sth/sb from one place to another in a vehicle.

examples.english: There was a loud cheer from everyone.
examples.persian: صدای بلند هورای همه بلند شد.

miniContext: A cheer is a shout of joy, support or praise.

examples.persian: ما از صافی آب استفاده می‌کنیم.

miniContext: A filter is a device containing paper, chemicals, etc. that a liquid or gas is passed through to remove unwanted material.

examples.english: There was a pause for a moment, then I continued.
examples.persian: یک لحظه مکث شد، بعد ادامه دادم.

miniContext: Pause means to stop talking or doing sth for a short time before continuing.

examples.english: Some of the men suffered torture.

miniContext: Torture is the act of causing sb severe pain in order to punish them or make them say sth.

examples.english: It was a real battle to win the game.
examples.persian: بردن این بازی واقعاً یک نبرد بود.

miniContext: A battle is a big effort that sb makes to solve a problem or succeed in a difficult situation.

meaning: پول گذاشتن در بانک (فعل) / بیعانه، سپرده (اسم)

examples.english: I have to leave a deposit of £200.

miniContext: Deposit (n) is a sum of money that is given as the first part of a larger payment.

examples.english: We must combat this threat to the environment.
examples.persian: باید با این تهدید علیه محیط‌زیست مبارزه کنیم.

miniContext: Combat (v) means to stop sth harmful or unpleasant from happening, or from getting worse.

examples.english: He asked me to read an extract.
examples.persian: از من خواست یک گزیده را بخوانم.

miniContext: An extract is a short piece from a book, piece of music, etc. that gives you an idea what the whole is like.

examples.english: They found no trace of the money.
examples.persian: هیچ اثری از پول پیدا نکردند.

miniContext: A trace is a mark or sign that sth existed or happened.

examples.english: The countries have had a long dispute.
examples.persian: آن کشورها یک اختلاف‌نظر طولانی داشته‌اند.

miniContext: Dispute (n) is an argument or a disagreement between two people, groups or countries.
